record.paper_title: Some open problems on excluding a uniform matroid
record.original_question: For every finite field F, is the class of F-representable matroids well-quasi-ordered by the minor relation? Equivalently, must every infinite set of F-representable matroids contain two members such that one is isomorphic to a minor of the other?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 2.1 (Well-Quasi-Ordering Conjecture). For any finite field F, any infinite set of F-representable matroids contains two matroids, one isomorphic to a minor of the other.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A matroid M is said to be representable over a field F if there is a matrix with entries in F whose columns, regarded as vectors, have the same independence structure as the ground set of M; equivalently, M is isomorphic to the matroid of linear dependencies of a multiset of vectors in some vector space over F. A minor of a matroid is any matroid obtained from it by a sequence of element deletions and contractions. A class C of matroids is well-quasi-ordered by the minor relation if for every infinite sequence M_1, M_2, M_3, ... of members of C there exist indices i < j such that M_i is isomorphic to a minor of M_j; equivalently, C contains no infinite antichain and no infinite strictly descending chain under the minor order.

Problem. Let F be an arbitrary finite field, and let C_F denote the class of all matroids representable over F. Is C_F well-quasi-ordered by the minor relation? That is, must every infinite set of F-representable matroids contain two members one of which is isomorphic to a minor of the other?
artifact.status_search_result: The bounded-branch-width case was proved by Geelen, Gerards, and Whittle (J. Combin. Theory Ser. B, 2002). A full proof of the general well-quasi-ordering conjecture for matroids representable over any fixed finite field was announced by Geelen, Gerards, and Whittle in 2014 as part of their Matroid Minors Project, alongside their proof of Rota's conjecture, but as of recent surveys the complete proof is still being written up and has not yet appeared in published form.

status_evidence.title: Solving Rota's Conjecture (Notices AMS)
status_evidence.snippet: Geelen, Gerards, and Whittle announced proofs of Rota's conjecture and the well-quasi-ordering conjecture for F-representable matroids, with the write-up still in progress.
status_evidence.claim: A proof of WQO for F-representable matroids was announced in 2014 but not yet fully published.

status_evidence.title: Branch-Width and Well-Quasi-Ordering in Matroids and Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Matroids representable over a fixed finite field with bounded branch-width are well-quasi-ordered under taking minors.
status_evidence.claim: The bounded-branch-width case of the conjecture is established.

status_evidence.title: Jim Geelen, Bert Gerards, and Geoff Whittle Solved Rota's Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Their Matroid Minors Project yields both Rota's conjecture and well-quasi-ordering of F-representable matroids.
status_evidence.claim: WQO over a finite field is claimed via the Matroid Minors Project.
